yaml:
# W6 fixture: a job NO REAL AGENT CAN CLAIM — the counterpart to
# `tools/w6/w6-synth-agent.sh`.
#
# `kind:w6synth` matches neither `agent1` nor `agent2` (both `kind:linux`), so
# a run of this job sits Queued until the synthetic identity claims it. That
# gives a harness a run whose whole lifecycle it owns: claim held as long as
# wanted, logs pushed on demand, finish deferred or never. The two real agents
# are never involved, so nothing the harness does perturbs a concurrently
# running real measurement.
#
# Same shape and same reason as `w35-probe` / `w36-probe`; it has its own
# selector purely so a W6 instrument cannot collide with a re-run of either W3
# scenario. The step below never executes — the run is terminalised through
# POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/runs/{runId}/finish — so its content is deliberately
# trivial; it exists only because a Job needs at least one step.
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w6-probe
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:w6synth
  steps:
    - name: never_runs
      run: echo "w6-probe placeholder — this step is never executed"
